summary: Vikram wants a confident, independent, well-travelled partner who is happy living with his parents in a vegetarian home. Several answers pull in different directions (Mumbai only vs moving abroad, a young age range vs 10+ years' experience), so they need clearing up before shortlisting.

clientDetails.profession: Chartered accountant, partner at an audit firm

preferences.label: Lives in Mumbai
preferences.sourceQuote: Partner must live in Mumbai. My practice is here and I'm not moving.

preferences.label: Open to moving abroad for the right person
preferences.detail: Would like to live in London for a few years.
preferences.sourceQuote: I'm also open to moving abroad for the right person

preferences.label: CA, MBA or law degree
preferences.sourceQuote: CA, MBA or a law degree

preferences.label: Well established, 10+ years of work experience
preferences.sourceQuote: I want someone well established in her career, ideally with 10+ years of work experience.

preferences.label: Strictly vegetarian household
preferences.sourceQuote: We are a strictly vegetarian household.

preferences.label: Comfortable living with his parents
preferences.sourceQuote: My parents will live with us after marriage. That is non-negotiable for me.

preferences.label: Gets along with his parents
preferences.sourceQuote: anyone who doesn't get along with my parents

preferences.label: Confident, independent, well-travelled
preferences.sourceQuote: Someone confident and independent who has seen the world.

preferences.label: Loves food and travel, tries everything
preferences.sourceQuote: I'd love a partner who'll try sushi and street food with me anywhere we go.

followUps.question: Is living in Mumbai a must, or would you genuinely move abroad for the right person?
followUps.reason: "Partner must live in Mumbai. I'm not moving" clashes with "open to moving abroad for the right person".

followUps.question: Someone aged 25 to 28 rarely has 10+ years of work experience. Which matters more: the age range or how established she is?
followUps.reason: The age range (25 to 28) and "10+ years of work experience" can't both be true for most people.

followUps.question: Does "strictly vegetarian household" apply only at home? Sushi and street food often include meat or fish.
followUps.reason: "Strictly vegetarian household" may clash with wanting a partner who tries sushi and street food everywhere.
